title: 第7章 听说了吗宗门大比外门也能报名第6章 筑基异象
slug: 修炼就修炼你们别总想留宿啊
lines: 宗门大比提前的消息，是赵长老在演武场当众宣布的。
“今年大比提前半个月，规则也改了——外门弟子可以报名。”
话音刚落，演武场上炸了锅。
“外门弟子也能参加？以前不是只有内门和核心弟子才能报名吗？”
“今年怎么回事，规矩全改了。”
“你没发现吗，今年改的规矩都是冲着一个人去的。”
说这话的人压低了声音，但周围几个人都听懂了他的意思，目光不约而同地往演武场角落瞟。
林尘刚练完剑，正把木剑往兵器架上放。
那些目光落在他身上，他假装没察觉。
外门弟子可报名，这规则改得确实像是冲着他来的。
掌门想看他到底有多少斤两，从筑基异象那天起就开始铺垫了。
“林尘！”
赵长老的声音从后面追上来。
林尘停住脚步，回头看见赵长老小跑着过来，脸上表情比以前复杂得多——这个以前天天骂他偷懒罚他砍柴的老头，现在看他的眼神里已经没了以前的嫌弃，取而代之的是一种说不清道不明的期待。
“你小子报名不报名？”
赵长老拍了拍他的肩膀，力道比以前任何一次都轻。
“好好打，别给外门丢人。”
说完就走了，步子很快，像是怕林尘看到他脸上的表情。
布告栏前围满了人。
林尘走过去的时候人群自动让开一条路。
告示上的墨迹还没干透：宗门大比三日后开始，外门弟子可报名，前三名奖励筑基丹，第一名额外奖励玄阶灵器一件。
“林尘来了。”
“他肯定报名吧？筑基初期，在外门已经是第一人了。”
“外门第一有什么用，大比里遇到内门核心照样挨打。”
“你没听说吗，刘峰之前在后山堵他，被他一拳挡回去了。刘峰可是筑基后期。”
“真的假的？筑基初期挡筑基后期？”
议论声此起彼伏，林尘一句也没接。
他把告示从头到尾看了一遍，转身挤出人群。
回到寒月阁隔壁的院子时，玉玲珑已经在石凳上坐着了。
她手里拿着一张赛程表，表情不太好看。
“师尊。”
玉玲珑把赛程表递给他。
“分组出来了。你的第一个对手，是刘峰。”
林尘接过赛程表看了一眼。
刘峰，内门核心弟子，筑基后期，戒律堂陈元的师侄。
他的名字和林尘的名字被划在同一个小组里，第一场就是两人对阵。
“陈元安排的。”
玉玲珑的声音压得很低。
“他想让刘峰在大比里光明正大地废了你。比试规则不能杀人，但重伤废丹田在规则允许范围内。刘峰是筑基后期，你是筑基初期。在别人看来，他重伤你是合理的。”
“他想废我丹田？”
“对。所以为师不会让你退赛。不但不退，还要你好好打。打疼他，打到戒律堂以后不敢再打你的主意。但也别打得太狠，留一点分寸，别把底牌全亮了。”
“弟子明白了。打狗给主人看，但不能让主人看出我的底细。”
content_en:
The news of the sect's competition being brought forward was announced by Elder Zhao in public at the martial arts arena.
"This year's competition is half a month ahead of schedule, and the rules have also been changed - outer disciples can sign up."
As soon as he finished speaking, the martial arts arena exploded.
"Can outer disciples also participate? Wasn't it true that only inner disciples and core disciples could sign up before?"
"What's going on this year? All the rules have changed."
"Have you not noticed that the rules changed this year are all aimed at one person?"
The person who said this lowered his voice, but several people around him understood what he meant and glanced at the corner of the martial arts arena in unison.
Lin Chen had just finished practicing his sword and was putting the wooden sword on the weapon rack.
Those eyes fell on him, and he pretended not to notice.
Outer disciples can sign up, and this rule change really seems to be aimed at him.
The leader wanted to see how much he weighed, and he had been laying the groundwork since the day of the foundation-building vision.
"Lin Chen!"
Elder Zhao's voice caught up from behind.
Lin Chen stopped and turned around to see Elder Zhao trotting over. The expression on his face was much more complicated than before - the old man who used to scold him for being lazy and punished him for cutting firewood every day, now looked at him without the previous disgust in his eyes, replaced by an indescribable expectation.
"Are you going to sign up or not?"
"Report."
"Okay."
Elder Zhao patted him on the shoulder, the force was lighter than ever before.
"Fight hard and don't embarrass the outer door."
After saying that, he left, walking very quickly, as if he was afraid that Lin Chen would see the expression on his face.
The notice board was crowded with people.
When Lin Chen walked over, the crowd automatically moved out of the way.
The ink on the notice has not yet dried: the sect competition will begin in three days. Outer disciples can sign up. The top three will be rewarded with foundation-building pills, and the first place will be rewarded with an additional Xuan-level spiritual weapon.
"Lin Chen is here."
"He must have signed up, right? In the early stages of foundation building, he is already the first person in the outer sect."
"What's the use of being number one in the outer sect? Dabiri will still get beaten when he meets the core of the inner sect."
"Didn't you hear that Liu Feng blocked him in the back mountain before, but he blocked him with a punch? Liu Feng is in the late stage of foundation building."
"Really or not? The early stage of foundation building blocks the later stage of foundation building?"
Discussions came and went, but Lin Chen didn't answer a word.
He read the notice from beginning to end, turned around and squeezed out of the crowd.
When she returned to the yard next to Hanyue Pavilion, Yu Linglong was already sitting on the stone bench.
She was holding a schedule in her hand and her expression was not very good.
"Master."
"Sit."
Yu Linglong handed him the schedule.
"The groups are out. Your first opponent is Liu Feng."
Lin Chen took a look at the schedule.
Liu Feng, a core disciple of the inner sect, in the late stage of foundation building, is the nephew of Chen Yuan of the Discipline Hall.
His name and Lin Chen's name were placed in the same group, and the two of them faced off in the first game.
"Chen Yuan arranged it."
Yu Linglong's voice was very low.
"He wants Liu Feng to destroy you openly in the competition. The rules of the competition cannot kill people, but severely injuring the Dantian is within the allowable range of the rules. Liu Feng is in the late stage of foundation establishment, and you are in the early stage of foundation establishment. In the eyes of others, it is reasonable for him to seriously injure you."
"He wants to destroy my Dantian?"
"Yes. That's why I won't let you withdraw from the game. Not only will you not withdraw, but you will also need to fight hard. It hurts him, and I won't dare to challenge you again after he gets to the Discipline Hall. But don't hit him too hard, keep a little discretion, and don't reveal all your cards."
"Disciple understands. Beat the dog to show the owner, but you can't let the owner see my true identity."
title_en: Chapter 7 Have you heard that outer sects can also register for the sect competition? Chapter 6 Foundation Building Vision
